errors.what: First weekday-bunching rule (alert dates only, binomial at 1%) fired on 4 of 60 null replays
errors.fix: added a weekday effect test on the history itself; checked on fresh seeds after fixing the rule: 0 of 200 false

doc_friction.issue: The pgrep hook rule ('bracket the first letter') also refuses a command where the unbracketed name appears elsewhere in the line (e.g. the output file name); cost two retries. Worth saying in cloud-session.md.

The Stripe section's 'Next' names a public real shop as an option but no host for one; archive.ics.uci.edu, huggingface.co and zenodo answer 403 through the proxy, raw.githubusercontent.com works (databricks/Spark-The-Definitive-Guide carries UCI Online Retail).

deviations.why: The pre-registration said a failed B2 changes nothing. All bars failed, but a diagnostic line (warn of a weekly cycle and suggest --period 7) was shipped anyway
deviations.did: The line changes no default and no setting; it reports a measured fact about the replay, with its own calibration set on design seeds and checked on fresh seeds (0/200 false, 180/200 closed-day caught)
